Resources

Put an idea to work.

Use & adapt

A few useful starting points.

These worksheets put the ideas in the notes into a form you can use. Download an editable Markdown file, open it in any text editor, or expand the preview and copy the text.

Complete them privately in your own files. Nothing you write into your copy is submitted to this website. They are thinking aids, not validated assessment tools.

Decision record

Separate what you knew before a decision from what you learned afterward.

Download decision record ↓Read the related note →
Preview decision record
# Decision record

A short worksheet to complete before an uncertain outcome is known.
Source note: https://nolankido.com/notes/decision-quality/

## Before deciding
Date:
Decision to make:
What matters most:
Options considered, including doing nothing:
Information available now:
Important uncertainties:
Consequences of being wrong:
How reversible is this choice?
Chosen option and reasons:
What evidence would make me change course?
Review date or trigger:

## After the outcome
What happened?
What was knowable at the time?
What did I overlook?
Which assumptions held up, and which changed?
Was the original choice reasonable given the information then available?
What will I change in the next decision?

Keep the original reasoning intact. Add the review separately.
This is a thinking aid, not a guarantee of a good outcome.
Prepared with AI assistance for nolankido.com. Copy and adapt for your own use.

Tool trust check

Define a claim, record independent checks, and make untested cases visible.

Download tool trust check ↓Read the related note →
Preview tool trust check
# Tool trust check

A worksheet for stating what a tool has, and has not, established.
Source note: https://nolankido.com/notes/trustworthy-tools/

Tool and version:
Task it is intended to perform:
Exact claim being tested:
Conditions under which the claim applies:

## Evidence
Small example with an independently checked answer:
Test input:
Expected result, recorded before running the test:
Actual result:
How independent is the reference from the tool?

## Failure conditions
Missing or malformed inputs:
Unusual or boundary cases:
Failure or interruption halfway through:
Recovery behavior:
Cases not yet tested:

## Use decision
Consequences of a wrong result:
What is safe to rely on now?
What still requires checking or human review?
Next test that could change this assessment:

Passing these checks does not prove correctness in untested conditions.

Preview learning loop
# Learning loop

A small planning and review sheet for one learnable capability.
Source note: https://nolankido.com/notes/learning-from-the-beginning/

Long-term goal:
Next concrete capability:
What would demonstrate that capability?
Foundation I may be missing:
One reliable starting resource:

## This session
One idea to study:
Problem or explanation to attempt without the reference:
My attempt:
Comparison with a reliable answer:
Mistake or gap I noticed:
Correction in my own words:
Next question:

## Return to it
Date to revisit the problem:
What can I now explain or do with less help?
What still needs focused practice?
A small project that would combine these skills:

Adapt the size of the session to the task and available time.
This is a learning aid, not a claim of a universal best method.
